name: Priya
story: Priya started her first full-time job in London two years ago. She has built up £10,000 in savings plus a small emergency pot, and can put aside £200 a month. She has never invested before and wants her money to grow towards a flat deposit in about ten years, but a big fall would worry her.

result.name: balanced
result.explanation: We used the lower of your comfort with risk (42%) and your ability to absorb a loss (69%), so your profile is balanced. This is a prototype policy, not a suitability assessment.
